create_PCA_decomposition: create a PCA model to find orthogonal directions of maximum variance in mixed signal data
run_FastICA_separation: run FastICA fit_transform to recover independent non-Gaussian source signals from mixed observations
compare_PCA_FastICA: compare PCA and FastICA component recovery on linearly mixed non-Gaussian source data
generate_non_gaussian_sources: generate synthetic non-Gaussian source signals using Student T distribution and mix with a matrix
plot_component_analysis_results: plot 2D scatter of true sources observations and recovered signals with component vectors for visual comparison
